name: farsi-smart-assistant
description: Dependency-free quality gates for the Farsi Smart Assistant extension.

scripts.release:gate: npm run test:product && npm run build:release && npm run verify:release
scripts.check: node --check keyboard_layout.js && node --check inline_checker.js && node --check popup.js && node --check background.js && node --check content_script.js && node --check logic.js && node --check options.js && node --check site_management.js && node --check evaluation/load-converter.mjs && node --check evaluation/run-evaluation.mjs && node --check scripts/build-browser-packages.mjs && node --check scripts/build-release-artifacts.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-release-artifacts.mjs && node --check scripts/audit-store-submission.mjs
scripts.test:product: npm run check && npm test && npm run eval
